lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill area. The spacing between centroids is relatively uniform, forming a predictable 2D grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, with high-luminance blobs serving as nodes at the intersections of these bands and horizontal rows.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Longitudinal linear features are present on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a light-above-shadow-below gradient, indicating at least three parallel structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed near the base and posterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated dark silhouettes (remoras) attached to the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and trailing from the ventral pelvic region.
